The batch therefore combines local condition curves and loading contrasts with selected high-width transfer points and ordinary anchors.","batch_rationale":"The batch concentrates its most structured measurements on m28, m107, m128, m129, m146, m167, m186, m204, m205, m213, and m114 response regions, where intermediate conditions can discriminate smooth, threshold, and saturated behavior. Matched or near-matched loading points test whether endpoint shifts arise from sample amount rather than solvent strength. High-width novel families provide transfer tests across carbonyl, oxygen-rich, basic, and heteroaromatic neighborhoods, while low-strength anchors and moderate-width points repair calibration where recent labels showed conservative or inflated intervals.
